  local!region1: { 1000, 1500 },
  local!region2: { 2000, 2500 },
  local!region3: { 3000 },
  local!total: sum(
    union(
      local!region1,
      local!region2,
      local!region3
    )
  ),
  /* 8. A document list contains: 
{"Report.pdf", "Image.jpg", "Data.xlsx", "Notes.pdf",
"Chart.png"} . Write an expression to extract only PDF files (files ending with ".pdf"). */
  local!document: {
    "Report.pdf",
    "Image.jpg",
    "Data.xlsx",
    "Notes.pdf",
    "Chart.png"
  },
  local!checkpdf: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"(
    items: local!document,
    expression: a!endsWith(fv!item, ".pdf")
  ),
  local!endwithpdf: index(
    local!document,
    wherecontains(true(), local!checkpdf),
    null()
  ),
  /* Q9. You have a list of numbers: 
{10, 25, 30, 15, 40, 5, 35} . Write an expression to filter and
return only numbers between 15 and 35 (inclusive) */
  local!numbers: { 10, 25, 30, 15, 40, 5, 35 },
  local!filter: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"(
    items: local!numbers,
    expression: if(
      and((fv!item >= 15), (fv!item <= 35)),
      fv!item,
      null()
    )
  ),
  local!nullcheck: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"(
    items: local!filter,
    expression: a!isNotNullOrEmpty(fv!item)
  ),
  local!returns: index(
    local!numbers,
    wherecontains(true(), local!nullcheck),
    null()
  ),
  /* 10. A priority list has items: 
{"High", "Low", "Medium", "High", "Critical"} . Write an
expression to move all "High" priority items to the beginning while keeping other items in their
original order. */
  local!items: {
    "High",
    "Low",
    "Medium",
    "High",
    "Critical"
  },
  local!high: index(
    local!items,
    wherecontains("High", local!items),
    null()
  ),
  local!remaining: index(
    local!items,
    wherecontains(
      false(),
      #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"(
        items: local!items,
        expression: fv!item = "High"
      )
    ),
    null()
  ),
  local!begining: a!flatten({ local!high, local!remaining }),
  /*11. You have employee ages: 
{25, 32, 45, 29, 51, 38, 41} . Write an expression to separate
them into two lists: under 40 and 40 or above */
  local!employee: { 25, 32, 45, 29, 51, 38, 41 },
  local!employee1:index(local!employee,wherecontains(true(),#"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"(items: local!employee,expression: fv!item>40)),null()),
  local!employee2:index(local!employee,wherecontains(true(),#"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"(items: local!employee,expression: fv!item<40)),null()),
  /* 12. A string list contains: 
{"apple", "BANANA", "Cherry", "GRAPE"} . Write an expression to
convert all items to lowercase and sort them alphabetically*/
  local!string:{"apple", "BANANA", "Cherry", "GRAPE"},
  local!lowercase:#"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"(
    items: local!string,
    expression: lower(fv!item)
  ),
  /* Q13. You have project IDs: 
{101, 102, 103, 104, 105} and need to create pairs: 
101", "Project 102", ...} . Write an expression to generate this list */
  local!Id:{101, 102, 103, 104, 105} ,
  local!project:#"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"(
    items: local!Id,
    expression: concat("Project","-",fv!item)
  ),
  /* 14. A feedback list contains: 
{"Project
{"Good", "Bad", "Good", "Excellent", "Good", "Bad"} .
Write an expression to count occurrences of each unique value and return a summary (e.g.,
"Good appears 3 times"). */
  local!feedback:{"Good", "Bad", "Good", "Excellent", "Good", "Bad"} ,
  local!text:union(local!feedback,local!feedback),
  local!appears:#"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"(
    items: local!text,
    expression: concat(fv!item," ","appears"," ",count(wherecontains(fv!item,local!feedback))," ","times"),
  ),
  /* 15. You have a nested list: 
{{1, 2}, {3, 4, 5}, {6}} . Write an expression to flatten it and
f
ind the sum of all numbers. */
  local!nestedlist:sum(a!flatten({{1, 2}, {3, 4, 5}, {6}})),
  /* Q16. A list of codes is: 
{"A1", "B2", "A3", "C1", "A5"} . Write an expression to extract only
codes that start with "A" */
  local!codes:{"A1", "B2", "A3", "C1", "A5"},
  local!extract:a!startsWith(local!codes,"A"),
  local!startwithA:index(local!codes, wherecontains(true(),local!extract),null()),
  /*17. You have task durations in hours: 
{2, 4, 1, 3, 5, 2} . Write an expression to double each
duration and return the new list. */
  local!duration:{2, 4, 1, 3, 5, 2},
  local!newlist:#"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"(
    items: local!duration,
    expression: product(fv!item,2)
  ),
  /*  18. Two lists represent matched pairs: Names = 
{"John", "Sarah", "Mike"} and Scores =
{85, 92, 78} . Write an expression to find the name of the person with the highest score.*/
  local!names:{"John", "Sarah", "Mike"},
  local!scores:{85, 92, 78} ,
  local!highestscore:index(local!names,wherecontains(touniformstring(max(local!scores)),touniformstring(local!scores)),null()),
  /* 19. A list contains: 
{5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30} . Write an expression to get every other element
starting from the first (result: 
{5, 15, 25} ). */
  local!element:{5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30},
  local!start:#"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"(
    items: local!element,
    expression: if(not(mod(fv!index,2)=0),fv!item,null())
  ),
  local!value:index(local!element,wherecontains(touniformstring(local!start),touniformstring(local!element)),null()),
  /* Q20. You have department codes: 
{"HR-001", "IT-002", "HR-003", "FIN-001", "IT-004"} .
Write an expression to group and count how many codes belong to each department (HR, IT,
FIN). */
  local!department: {"HR-001", "IT-002", "HR-003", "FIN-001", "IT-004"},

  local!deptNames: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"(
    items: local!department,
    expression: left(fv!item, find("-", fv!item) - 1)
  ),
  /* Result: {"HR", "IT", "HR", "FIN", "IT"} */

  local!unique: union(local!deptNames, local!deptNames),
  /* Result: {"HR", "IT", "FIN"} */

  local!summary: #"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"(
    items: local!unique,
    expression: fv!item & " - " & count(wherecontains(fv!item, local!deptNames)) & " codes"
  ),
 
  {
    local!employeerecords.name,
    local!duplicates,
    local!notapproved,
    local!count,
    local!expression,

a!localVariables(
  /* 21. An employee's years of service is 8 and performance rating is "Excellent". Write an
expression to determine bonus: if years >= 5 AND rating is "Excellent", bonus is 10000; if years
>= 5 OR rating is "Excellent", bonus is 5000; otherwise 2000. */
  local!employeeservice: 8,
  local!employeeperformance: "Excellent",
  local!condition: if(
    and(
      (local!employeeperformance = "Excellent"),
      (local!employeeservice >= 5)
    ),
    concat("bonus is 10000"),
    concat("bonus is 2000")
  ),
  /* 22. A student has scores: Math = 75, Science = 82, English = 68. Write an expression to return
"Pass" if the average is >= 70 AND no individual score is below 60, otherwise "Fail". */
  local!math: 75,
  local!science: 82,
  local!english: 68,
  local!average: average(local!math, local!science, local!english),
  local!result: if(local!average >= 70, "Pass", "Fail"),
  /* 23. An order amount is $1500 and customer type is "Premium". Write an expression to calculate
discount: Premium customers get 15% if amount > 1000, otherwise 10%. Regular customers get
5% if amount > 1000, otherwise 0%. */
  local!amount: "$1500",
  local!discount: if(tointeger(local!amount) > 1000, 0.15, 0.10),
  local!discountamount: local!amount * local!discount,
  local!finalamount: local!amount - local!discountamount,
  /* 24. A product has stock = 0 and backorder = true. Write an expression to return status: "Out of
Stock - Available for Backorder" if stock is 0 and backorder is true, "Out of Stock" if stock is 0 and
backorder is false, "In Stock" otherwise. */
  local!stock: 0;local!backorder: true(),
  local!checkavailability: if(
    and(
      (local!stock = 0),
      (local!backorder = true())
    ),
    "Out of
Stock - Available for Backorder",
    "In Stock"
  ),
  /* 25. Three checkboxes have values: option1 = true, option2 = false, option3 = true. Write an
expression to return "At least 2 selected" if 2 or more are true, "Only 1 selected" if exactly 1 is true,
"None selected" if all are false. */
  local!option1:true(),
  local!option2:false(),
  local!option3:true(),
  local!count:tointeger(local!option1) + tointeger(local!option2) + tointeger(local!option3),
  local!result1:if(
    local!count>=2,
    "At least 2 selected",
    if(local!count>=1,
    "Only 1 selected",
    "None Selected")
  ),
  /* Q26. A loan applicant has creditScore = 720, income = 65000, employmentYears = 4. Write an
expression to determine approval: Approved if (creditScore > 700 AND income > 50000) OR
employmentYears > 5, otherwise Denied. */
  local!creditscore: 720,
  local!income : 65000,
  local!employmentyears: 4,
local!approve:if(
  or(and((local!creditscore>700),local!income>50000),local!employmentyears>5),
  "Approved",
  "Denied"
),
/*27. A date field has value date(2024, 2, 15). Write an expression to determine quarter: Q1 (Jan
Mar), Q2 (Apr-Jun), Q3 (Jul-Sep), or Q4 (Oct-Dec).*/
  local!date: date(2024, 2, 15),
  local!monthNum: month(local!date),
  local!quarter:if(
    local!monthNum<=3,
    "Q1",
    if(and((local!monthNum>=4),(local!monthNum<=6)),
    "Q2",
    if(and((local!monthNum>=7),(local!monthNum<=9)),
    "Q3",
    "Q4"
    )
    )
  ),
  /* 28. A ticket priority is "High" and days open is 5. Write an expression to return escalation level:
"Critical" if priority is "High" and days > 3, "Warning" if priority is "Medium" and days > 7,
"Normal" otherwise. */
  local!priority:"Medium",
  local!days:8,
  local!escalation:a!match(
    value: true(),
    equals: and((local!priority="High"),(local!days>3)),
    then: "Critical",
    equals: and((local!priority="Medium"),(local!days>7)),
    then: "Medium",
    default: "Normal"
  ),
  
  /* 29. A user's role is in the list 
{"Admin", "Manager", "Supervisor"} and they're trying to
access a restricted page. Write an expression to return true only if they have one of these roles. */
  local!usersrole:"Manager",
  local!roles:{"Admin", "Manager", "Supervisor"},
  local!pageaccess:contains(local!roles,local!usersrole),
  /* 30. An exam has passingScore = 70, studentScore = 68, extraCredit = 5. Write an expression to
return "Pass" if studentScore + extraCredit >= passingScore, otherwise "Fail". */
  local!passingscore: 70,
  local!studentscore: 68,
  local!extracredit:5,
  local!passorfail:if(
    (sum(local!studentscore,local!extracredit))>=local!passingscore,
    "Pass",
    "Fail"
  ),
  /* 31. A temperature is 28°C and humidity is 75%. Write an expression to return comfort level:
"Uncomfortable" if temp > 25 AND humidity > 70, "Comfortable" otherwise. */
  local!temperature: tointeger("28c"),
  local!humidity: tointeger("75%"),
  local!comfortlevel:if(
    and(local!temperature,local!humidity),
    "Uncomfortable",
    "Comfortable"
  ),
  /* 32. A product category is "Electronics" and price is $350. Write an expression to determine tax
rate: Electronics over $300 get 18% tax, Electronics $300 or less get 12% tax, other categories get
8% tax. */
  local!category:"Electronics",
  local!price:350,
  local!tax:a!match(
    value: true(),
    whenTrue: and((local!category="Electronics"),(local!price>300)), then: 0.18,
    whenTrue: and((local!category="Electronics"),(local!price<300)), then: 0.12,
    default: 0.08
  ),
  /* 33. Three validators return: validator1 = true, validator2 = true, validator3 = false. Write an
expression to return "Valid" only if ALL validators are true, otherwise list which validators failed. */
  local!validator:true(),
  local!validator1:true(),
  local!validator2:false(),
local!list:a!match(
  value: true(),
  whenTrue: and(local!validator,local!validator1,local!validator2), then: "Valid",
  default: "Failed"
),
/*34. An age is 17 and parentalConsent = true. Write an expression to return "Eligible" if age >=
18 OR (age >= 16 AND parentalConsent is true), otherwise "Not Eligible".*/
local!age:17,
local!parent:true(),
local!iseligible:or(local!age>=18,and((local!age>=16),(local!parent=true()))),
local!return:if(
  local!iseligible,
  "Eligible",
  "Not Eligible"
),
/*35. A schedule has startTime = 9 and endTime = 17 (24-hour format). Current time is 14. Write
an expression to return "Active" if current time is between start and end (inclusive), "Inactive"
otherwise.*/
local!starttime: 9,
local!endtime:17,
local!currenttime:14,
local!checktime:if(
  and((local!currenttime>=local!starttime),(local!currenttime<=local!endtime)),
  "Active",
  "InActive"
),
/*36. A shipping weight is 25 kg and destination is "International". Write an expression to
calculate shipping cost: Domestic is $5 per kg up to 20kg, then $7 per kg. International is $10 per
kg up to 20kg, then $12 per kg.*/

local!weight: 25,
local!destination: "International",
local!threshold: 20,
local!rates: if(
  local!destination = "International",
  { base: 10, premium: 12 },
  { base: 5, premium: 7 }
),
local!shippingCost: if(
  local!weight <= local!threshold,
  local!weight * local!rates.base,
  (local!threshold * tointeger((local!rates.base)) + (
    (local!weight - local!threshold) * tointeger(local!rates.premium)
  )
)
),

/*37. A password has length 10, contains numbers = true, contains symbols = false. Write an
expression to return strength: "Strong" if length >= 10 AND contains numbers AND contains
symbols, "Medium" if length >= 8 AND (contains numbers OR contains symbols), "Weak"
otherwise*/
local!passwordlength: 10,
local!containsnumber:true(),
local!containssymbols:false(),
local!checkpassword:a!match(
  value: true(),
  whenTrue: and(local!passwordlength>=10,and(local!containsnumber,local!containssymbols)),then: "Strong",
  whenTrue: and(local!passwordlength>=8,or(local!containsnumber,local!containssymbols)),then: "Medium",
  default: "Weak"
),
/*38. A subscription expires on date(2024, 12, 31) and today is date(2024, 12, 15). Write an
expression to return "Expiring Soon" if expires within 30 days, "Active" if more than 30 days
remain, "Expired" if expiry date has passed.*/
local!lastdate:day(date(2024,12,31)),
local!todaydate:day(date(2024,12,15)),
local!currentdate:tointeger(local!lastdate-local!todaydate),
local!value:if(
  local!currentdate>30,
  "Active",
  if(
    local!currentdate<30,
    "InActive",
    "Expried"
  )
),
/*39. Multiple conditions: isWeekend = false, isHoliday = true, isEmergency = false. Write an
expression to determine if office is open: Closed if weekend OR (holiday AND NOT emergency),
Open otherwise.*/
local!isWeekend:false(),
local!isHoliday:true(),
local!isEmergency:false(),
local!checking:if(
  or(local!isWeekend,and(local!isHoliday,not(local!isEmergency))),
  "Closed",
  "Open"
),

/*40. A score is 85 on a test with curve = 5 and extraPoints = 2. Write an expression to determine
f
inal grade: A (90+), B (80-89), C (70-79), D (60-69), F (below 60) after adding curve and
extraPoints.*/
local!score:85,
local!curve:5,
local!extrapoints:2,
local!total:sum(local!score,local!curve,local!extrapoints),
local!finalgrade:a!match(
  value: local!total,
  whenTrue: (local!total>=90), then: "A",
  whenTrue: (local!total>=80), then: "B",
  whenTrue: (local!total>=70), then: "C",
  whenTrue: (local!total>=60), then: "D",
  default: "F"
),
{
    local!condition,
    local!result,
    local!finalamount,
    local!checkavailability,
   
    local!result1,
    local!approve,
    
    local!quarter,
    local!escalation,
    local!pageaccess,
    local!passorfail,
    local!comfortlevel,
    local!tax,
    local!list,
    local!return,
    local!checktime,
    local!shippingCost,
    local!checkpassword,
    local!value,
    local!checking,
    local!finalgrade
  }
)

a!localVariables(
  /* 41. An email address is "
John.Doe@Company.com". Write an expression to extract just the
username part before the "@" symbol (result: "John.Doe"). */
  local!email:"John.Doe@Company.com",
  local!username:if(
    a!isNotNullOrEmpty(local!email),
    index(split(local!email,"@"),1,null()),
    null()
  ),
  /* 42. A full name is " SMITH, JOHN " (last name, first name format with extra spaces). Write an
expression to clean it up and convert to "John Smith" format. */
  local!fullname:" SMITH, JOHN ",
  local!extraspace:trim(local!fullname),
  local!convert:split(local!extraspace,","),
  local!firstname:index(local!convert,2,""),
  local!lastname:index(local!convert,1,""),
  local!full:proper(concat(local!firstname," ",local!lastname)),
  
  /* Q43. A product SKU is "ELEC-LAP-2024-001". Write an expression to extract the year "2024"
from the SKU */
  local!product:"ELEC-LAP-2024-001",
  local!extract:split(local!product,"-"),
  local!year:index(local!extract,wherecontains("2024",local!extract),""),
  /* 44. You have firstName = "Jane" and lastName = "Doe". Write an expression to create initials
"J.D." */
  local!Name1:"Jane",
  local!Name2:"Doe",
  local!firsta:left(local!Name1,1),
  local!lasta:left(local!Name2,1),
  local!initials:concat(local!firsta,".",local!lasta,"."),
  /* 45. A phone number is "1234567890". Write an expression to format it as "(123) 456-7890". */
  local!phonenumber:"1234567890",
  local!phone:left(local!phonenumber,3),
  local!number1:mid(local!phonenumber, 4, 3),
  local!number2:right(local!phonenumber,4),
  local!fullphonenumber:concat("(",local!phone,")"," ",local!number1,"-",local!number2),
  /* Q46. A sentence is "The Quick Brown Fox Jumps". Write an expression to count how many
words are in the sentence. */
  local!sentence:"The Quick Brown Fox Jumps",
  local!characters:count(split(local!sentence," ")),
  /*47. A file path is "/documents/reports/2024/Q1/sales.pdf". Write an expression to extract just
the filename "sales.pdf".  */
  local!filepath:"/documents/reports/2024/Q1/sales.pdf",
  local!split1:split(local!filepath,"/"),
  local!just:index(local!split1,wherecontains("sales.pdf",local!split1),null()),
  /*  A string is "apple,banana,cherry,date". Write an expression to replace all commas with
semicolons and convert to uppercase. */
  local!string:"apple,banana,cherry,date",
  local!semicolons:split(local!string,","),
  local!uppercase:#"SYSTEM_SYSRULES_forEach"(
    items: local!semicolons,
    expression: upper(fv!item)
  ),
  /* 49. A product code is "ABC-123-XYZ". Write an expression to check if it follows the pattern: 3

  local!productcode:"ABC-123-XYZ",
  local!isvalid: regexmatch("^[A-Za-z]{3}-[0-9]{3}-[A-Za-z]{3}$",local!productcode),
  /* 50. A description is "This is a sample text with many words". Write an expression to extract the
first 20 characters and add "..." if the text is longer than 20 characters. */
  local!description: "This is a sample text with many words",
  local!words:len(local!description),
  local!check:if(local!words>20,
  "Text is longer than 20 characters",
  left(local!description,20)),
  /* 51. Two strings: string1 = "Hello World" and string2 = "HELLO WORLD". Write an expression to

  local!string1:"Hello World",
  local!string2:"HELLO WORLD",

  local!meeting1:datetime(2024, 6, 15, 14, 30, 0),

  local!deadline:date(2024,12,25),

calculate the due date (30 days after invoice date). */
  local!invoicedate:date(2024,6,1),
  local!duedate:todate(local!invoicedate+30),

month. */
  local!dates:date(2024,6,15),
  local!endmonth:todate(eomonth(local!dates,-1)),

  local!birthdate:date(1990,5,20),
  local!todaydate:date(2024,6,15),

  local!datetime:datetime(2024, 6, 15, 9, 30, 0),
  local!datetime1:datetime(2024, 6, 15,14, 45, 0),
  local!hour:hour(local!datetime)*60 + minute(local!datetime),
  local!hour1:hour(local!datetime1)*60 + minute(local!datetime1),
  local!totalhour:local!hour1-local!hour,

  local!fiscalyear:date(2024,6,15),

  local!isdate:todate(local!contract+90),

  local!checking:if(local!checkdate<=local!isdate,"valid period","is not valid period"),
  /* 73. Today is date(2024, 6, 15). Write an expression to get the date 3 months from now */
  local!express:date(2024,6,15),
  local!emonth:todate(edate(local!express,3)),

  local!shiftstart:time(9, 0, 0),

  local!onlyhour1:hour(local!shiftclosing)*60 + minute(local!shiftclosing),
  local!onlyhours:(local!onlyhour1-local!onlyhour)/60,

  local!event:date(2024,12,25),
